fieldTriage.name: Field Triage Kit
fieldTriage.desc: Heals on a member below {FIELD_TRIAGE_THRESHOLD|pct}% max HP heal +{FIELD_TRIAGE_BONUS}.

warDrum.name: War Drum
warDrum.desc: After a member casts their Ability, their next auto-attack deals double.

prayerBeads.name: Fidget Beads
prayerBeads.desc: +{PRAYER_BEADS_MP} MP each time the draw pile is reshuffled.

vanguardsBanner.name: Team Pennant
vanguardsBanner.desc: Members at full HP deal +{VANGUARD_BONUS} on their auto-attack.

martyrsIcon.name: Guardian Feather
martyrsIcon.desc: Once per fight, a member death becomes survival at 1 HP.

pactOfSilence.name: Cursed Coffee
pactOfSilence.desc: CURSE — you can no longer Rest; gain +{PACT_PASSIVE_MP} MP at the start of each turn.

rustyCrown.name: Rusty Crown
rustyCrown.desc: CURSE — normal enemies attack +{RUSTY_CROWN_ATTACK} harder (bosses are proud enough); fight wins pay +{RUSTY_CROWN_GOLD}g.

loneWolf.name: Lone Wolf Totem
loneWolf.desc: While fielding {SMALL_PARTY_MAX} or fewer members, each of them deals +{LONE_WOLF_DMG} damage.

focusStone.name: Thinking Cap
focusStone.desc: While fielding {SMALL_PARTY_MAX} or fewer members, +{FOCUS_STONE_MP} max MP (fewer bodies to tend).

warband.name: Roomy Tent
warband.desc: Fielded members gain +{WARBAND_HP_PER_SEAT} max HP for each empty deploy seat.

ossuaryBell.name: Second-Wind Chime
ossuaryBell.desc: Whenever a member drops below {OSSUARY_THRESHOLD|pct}% max HP, they gain Regen {OSSUARY_REGEN}.

beaconOfSecondSun.name: Beacon of the Second Sun
beaconOfSecondSun.desc: Whenever a card heals a member to full, draw {BEACON_DRAW}.

twinCenser.name: Buddy System
twinCenser.desc: Single-target heal cards also heal the most wounded other member {TWIN_CENSER_SPLASH}.

chantersIdol.name: Chanter's Idol
chantersIdol.desc: The first card you play each turn does not break your channel.

pilgrimsFlask.name: Nap Sack
pilgrimsFlask.desc: Every Rest also heals your most wounded member {PILGRIM_FLASK_HEAL}.

surgeonsThread.name: Spare Bandages
surgeonsThread.desc: Between-fight recovery rises to {SURGEON_THREAD_HEAL_PCT|pct}% of max HP (from {HERO_HEAL_PCT|pct}%).

beggarsBowl.name: Beggar's Bowl
beggarsBowl.desc: CURSE — card rewards after a won fight offer {BEGGARS_BOWL_REWARD_SIZE} choices instead of 3; +{BEGGARS_BOWL_GOLD}g per won fight.
